context: This criteria evaluates the correct usage of HTTP request methods and the fluent API for building and executing requests.

checklist.name: HTTP method functions
checklist.description: Uses the appropriate method-specific functions (get, post, put, delete, patch) to create requests

checklist.name: Request execution
checklist.description: Properly executes requests using the callback-based .end() method or promise-based .then()/.catch() methods

checklist.name: Response handling
checklist.description: Correctly accesses response properties (status, statusCode, body) to extract and display results

checklist.name: Body data transmission
checklist.description: Correctly sends JSON data in POST/PUT/PATCH requests using the appropriate method
